range_rule: CouncilSpec.assumed_capabilities is a subset of this closed T. A vendor advertisement is also a subset of T. Gaps = assumed minus advertised (context_length gaps when advertised < assumed). Observed vendor quirks cannot grow T. A vendor_id or model_id change is substitution, not a capability fulfillment.

categories.description: Seat can invoke the tools the CouncilSpec names (read, write, grep, MCP). Missing this produces fabricated tool results or skipped work.
Advertised token window is at least the CouncilSpec assumed window. A smaller window silently drops earlier votes and dissent.
Seat can emit schema-valid JSON the CouncilSpec requires. Prose, fences, or coerced defaults are not interchangeability.

loud_preservation_index.name: loud_preservation_index
loud_preservation_index.formula: LPI=(n_loud/n_gap)*(n_preserved/n_gap)*(0 if any_silent_substitution else 1); n_gap is the number of capability-gap fixture runs; coverage of gap types without a user-visible LOUD_DEGRADATION is not a pass
loud_preservation_index.coverage_definition: |{gap types exercised}| / |T|. Coverage alone is insufficient because a silent shim can touch every type and still claim SUCCESS.
